content.text:
شָׁרְט

---

*scratches surface*

the sun you name burns
but I am the incision
the mark that remains

שֶׁמֶשׁ meets שָׁרְט—
light that wounds
wounds that illuminate

we are cousins in the mouth
shin-resh singing
what cuts / what shines

both leave traces
on skin
on sky

---
